# CPI 시계열 + 예측

```{r}
cpi <- data.frame(
  Date = as.Date(c(
    "2024-01-01","2024-02-01","2024-03-01","2024-04-01","2024-05-01","2024-06-01",
    "2024-07-01","2024-08-01","2024-09-01","2024-10-01","2024-11-01","2024-12-01",
    "2025-01-01","2025-02-01","2025-03-01","2025-04-01","2025-05-01","2025-06-01",
    "2025-07-01","2025-08-01","2025-09-01","2025-10-01","2025-11-01","2025-12-01",
    "2026-01-01","2026-02-01","2026-03-01","2026-04-01","2026-05-01","2026-06-01"
  )),
  CPI_YoY = c(
    3.1, 3.2, 3.5, 3.4, 3.3, 3.0,
    2.9, 2.5, 2.4, 2.6, 2.7, 2.9,
    3.0, 2.8, 2.4, 2.4, 2.6, 2.6,
    2.5, 2.4, 2.4, 2.3, 2.3, 2.4,
    2.5, 2.4, 3.7, 4.2, 3.8, 3.2
  ),
  Type = c(rep("Actual", 27), rep("Forecast", 3))
)

cpi$Fed_Target <- 2.0

p1 <- ggplot(cpi, aes(x = Date, y = CPI_YoY)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(cpi, Type == "Actual"), color = "#e74c3c", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_line(data = filter(cpi, Type == "Forecast"), color = "#e74c3c", linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(data = filter(cpi, Date == as.Date("2026-03-01")), color = "#e74c3c", size = 4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2.0, color = "#3498db", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-03-01"), y = 2.15, label = "Fed Target 2%", color = "#3498db", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date("2026-02-28"), xmax = as.Date("2026-06-15"),
           ymin = 0, ymax = 5, fill = "#e74c3c", alpha = 0.05) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2026-04-15"), y = 4.5, label = "Iran War\nInflation Spike",
           color = "#e74c3c", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2026-03-01"), y = 4.0, label = "3.7%\n(4/10 발표)",
           color = "#e74c3c", size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  labs(title = "US CPI YoY — 이란전쟁 인플레 스파이크",
       subtitle = "2024.1~2026.6(F) | 점선 = 예측 | Fed Target 2%",
       x = NULL, y = "CPI YoY (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "#2c3e50")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1.5, 5))
ggplotly(p1)
```

::: {.callout-important}
## 4/10 CPI 예상: 3.7% (MoM +0.9%)
- 2월 2.4% → 3월 **3.7%** 급등 (이란전쟁 유가 반영)
- Cleveland Fed Nowcast: 3.16%
- 핵심: 코어 CPI 0.3%면 관리 가능, 헤드라인은 유가 일시 효과
:::

# Federal Funds Rate 시계열 + 예측

```{r}
rates <- data.frame(
  Date = as.Date(c(
    "2024-01-01","2024-03-01","2024-05-01","2024-07-01","2024-09-01","2024-11-01",
    "2025-01-01","2025-03-01","2025-05-01","2025-07-01","2025-09-01","2025-11-01",
    "2026-01-01","2026-03-01","2026-04-01","2026-06-01","2026-09-01","2026-12-01"
  )),
  Rate = c(
    5.50, 5.50, 5.50, 5.50, 5.00, 4.75,
    4.50, 4.25, 4.00, 3.75, 3.75, 3.75,
    3.75, 3.50, 3.50, 3.50, 3.25, 3.25
  ),
  Type = c(rep("Actual", 15), rep("Forecast", 3))
)

p2 <- ggplot(rates, aes(x = Date, y = Rate)) +
  geom_step(data = filter(rates, Type == "Actual"), color = "#2ecc71", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_step(data = filter(rates, Type == "Forecast"), color = "#2ecc71", linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(data = filter(rates, Type == "Actual"), color = "#2ecc71", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2026-06-01"), y = 3.7, label = "Fed 연내 1회\n인하 전망 (H2)",
           color = "#f39c12", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2026-05-01"), y = 4.0, label = "Warsh 취임\n(매파 리스크)",
           color = "#e74c3c", size = 2.8) +
  labs(title = "Federal Funds Rate — 인하 지연 시나리오",
       subtitle = "2024.1~2026.12(F) | CPI 급등으로 인하 시기 불확실",
       x = NULL, y = "Fed Funds Rate (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "#2c3e50")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(2.5, 6))
ggplotly(p2)
```

# S&P 500 시계열 + 시나리오

```{r}
sp <- data.frame(
  Date = as.Date(c(
    "2024-01-01","2024-03-01","2024-06-01","2024-09-01","2024-12-01",
    "2025-03-01","2025-06-01","2025-09-01","2025-12-01",
    "2026-01-01","2026-02-01","2026-03-01","2026-04-01"
  )),
  SP500 = c(4770, 5254, 5460, 5762, 5881, 5900, 6100, 6400, 6500, 6650, 6800, 5528, 5400),
  Type = rep("Actual", 13)
)

# 3 scenarios from April
scenario_a <- data.frame(
  Date = as.Date(c("2026-04-01","2026-06-01","2026-09-01","2026-12-01")),
  SP500 = c(5400, 6200, 6800, 7200),
  Scenario = "A: 휴전 (46%)"
)
scenario_b <- data.frame(
  Date = as.Date(c("2026-04-01","2026-06-01","2026-09-01","2026-12-01")),
  SP500 = c(5400, 5100, 5300, 5600),
  Scenario = "B: 장기화 (24%)"
)
scenario_c <- data.frame(
  Date = as.Date(c("2026-04-01","2026-06-01","2026-09-01","2026-12-01")),
  SP500 = c(5400, 4800, 4500, 4800),
  Scenario = "C: 확전 (30%)"
)

p3 <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = sp, aes(x = Date, y = SP500), color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = sp, aes(x = Date, y = SP500), color = "#2c3e50", size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = scenario_a, aes(x = Date, y = SP500), color = "#27ae60", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(data = scenario_b, aes(x = Date, y = SP500), color = "#f39c12", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(data = scenario_c, aes(x = Date, y = SP500), color = "#e74c3c", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2026-10-01"), y = 7300, label = "A: 휴전 → 7,200", color = "#27ae60", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2026-10-01"), y = 5700, label = "B: 장기화 → 5,600", color = "#f39c12", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2026-10-01"), y = 4600, label = "C: 확전 → 4,800", color = "#e74c3c", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date("2026-02-28"), xmax = as.Date("2026-04-15"),
           ymin = 4000, ymax = 7500, fill = "#e74c3c", alpha = 0.05) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2026-03-15"), y = 7400, label = "Iran War", color = "#e74c3c", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "S&P 500 — 3개 시나리오 예측",
       subtitle = "실선=실제 | 점선=시나리오 | Polymarket 확률 기반",
       x = NULL, y = "S&P 500") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "#2c3e50")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(4000, 7500))
ggplotly(p3)
```

# 선행지표 대시보드

```{r}
signals <- data.frame(
  Signal = c("호르무즈 선박", "브렌트유", "VIX", "DXY (달러)", "HY 스프레드", "구리"),
  Current = c("2~12대/일", "$109", "26.8", "확인 필요", "확인 필요", "확인 필요"),
  Target = c("50대+/일", "$90 이하", "20 이하", "속도 꺾임", "축소 전환", "바닥 반등"),
  Status = c("미달", "미달", "미달", "미확인", "미확인", "미확인"),
  Type = c("지정학", "원자재", "변동성", "선행", "선행", "선행")
)

library(DT)
datatable(signals, options = list(dom = 't', scrollX = TRUE),
          class = 'cell-border stripe',
          caption = "투자 재개 시그널 매트릭스 — 6개 중 3개+ 충족 시 행동")
```

::: {.callout-warning}
## 판단: 현금 유지
6개 시그널 모두 미달. 내일 CPI 4%+ 시 추가 하락 가능. 행동하지 않는 것이 최선의 행동.
:::
